metadata.task_description: Implement all fixes from the code review report (15 findings) to improve code quality, security, and readability

issues: SEC-002 (line 238-245): Token stored in multiple localStorage keys
READ-002 (line 25-41): Magic strings repeated throughout module
READ-003 (line 88-204): Missing JSDoc on public APIs
READ-005 (line 69-75): Unclear variable naming in buildQuery
CORR-001 (line 362): Race condition in pagination watcher
CORR-002 (line 348-358): Missing error visibility in delete operation
SEC-004 (line 394): Alert used for error display
READ-004 (line 243-399): Complex component logic needs decomposition

coordinator/static/dist/index.html.notes: Generated by Vite build process. Changes to api.ts and Users.vue will be reflected in dist output. No direct edits recommended.

pagination.pattern: watch(page, () => fetchUsers()) — direct call without concurrency check
pagination.risk: Race condition on rapid pagination clicks
similar_patterns: Jobs.vue:260-268 uses onFilterChange() -> page reset -> load() pattern
Agents.vue:150+ uses goToPage(n) -> page set -> load() pattern

error_handling.pattern: catch -> set error.value, close modal, UI can't show error
error_handling.risk: User doesn't see error message before modal closes
error_handling.comparison: Jobs.vue handles errors differently, doesn't close modal until confirmed

filename_handling.pattern: Simple regex parse: disposition.match(/filename=(.+)$/), no sanitization
filename_handling.risk: Path traversal possible with ../filename or special chars

token_storage.pattern: Dual keys: arcvault_jwt and arcvault_token both stored/retrieved
token_storage.risk: Inconsistent state, stale tokens if one key isn't cleared

csrf_protection.pattern: No CSRF token in request headers

error_display.pattern: alert() for errors exposed to user
error_display.risk: Poor UX, potential XSS if error contains user input

response_validation.pattern: Some endpoints validated (getGroups, login, refreshToken), others not (getAgents, getJobs)
response_validation.gap: Inconsistent validation, API contract breaks won't be caught early

lazy_loading.pattern: All modals show immediately with v-if when data in ref
lazy_loading.note: Current approach is acceptable for this component size

function_definition.pattern: Mixed: const login = async () => {} vs const logout = () =>
function_definition.consistency_gap: login uses fetch directly, logout uses request() helper

variable_naming.pattern: Short variable names: q, k, v in buildQuery

component_complexity.pattern: Users.vue has 157 lines of script logic with 7 modals and multiple concerns

critical_constraints: MUST consolidate token keys from arcvault_jwt + arcvault_token to single key (impacts api.ts and useAuth.js)
MUST sanitize filename from Content-Disposition header before using (SEC-001 HIGH priority)
MUST fix race condition in pagination watcher (CORR-001 HIGH priority)
integration_constraints: Token consolidation affects 2 files: api.ts and useAuth.js (handle together in same fix)
getToken() is used in 5 locations: api.ts, useAuth.js, UpdateModal.vue, AgentUpdateModal.vue, Credentials.vue, Users.vue
Filename sanitization is localized to api.ts downloadInstaller() function
Error display changes in Users.vue may need CSS/modal template updates
Functions like downloadInstaller and downloadBootstrapScript should share error handling pattern
backwards_compatibility: If migrating token keys, must handle old arcvault_jwt key for existing users
API endpoint paths should remain stable (/downloads/installer, /api/admin/bootstrap.ps1)

conflict_detection.reasoning: Fixes are localized to two source files (api.ts, Users.vue) with minimal cross-component dependencies. Token consolidation affects multiple files but changes are backwards-compatible. No architectural conflicts detected.

interaction_risks.mitigation: Update both files in same commit, handle migration during login
Add loading check, isolated to one component
Create STORAGE_KEYS constant in api.ts, useAuth.js can import it

conflict_detection.build_process_notes: index.html is generated by Vite build. No edits needed there. Changes to api.ts and Users.vue will be reflected in coordinator/static/dist/index.html after rebuild.

correctness_findings.race_condition_scope: Users.vue pagination watcher only. Similar patterns in Jobs.vue and Agents.vue use different approach (explicit load() calls), not affected.
correctness_findings.error_handling_scope: Users.vue delete operation. Other components handle errors differently (Jobs.vue keeps modal open).

security_findings.token_storage_footprint: Used in 5 files: api.ts (definition), useAuth.js (override with same pattern), UpdateModal.vue, AgentUpdateModal.vue, Credentials.vue, Users.vue
security_findings.filename_sanitization_scope: downloadInstaller() only. downloadBootstrapScript() also downloads but uses hardcoded filename 'bootstrap.ps1'.
security_findings.csrf_protection_status: Backend verification required. No existing CSRF tokens in codebase. SEC-003 marked as MEDIUM because backend may not require it.

performance_findings.validation_gap: getAgents and getJobs lack response validation. All other paginated endpoints (getGroups, users list) also lack validation. Pattern inconsistency suggests PERF-001 applies to multiple endpoints.

readability_findings.function_definition_inconsistency: login() uses fetch directly (line 89-93), logout() uses request() helper (line 97-98). Pattern should be consistent across all API functions.
readability_findings.jsdoc_coverage_gap: 0% coverage on public APIs. Dashboard has 38 source files. api.ts is critical module with no documentation.
readability_findings.component_decomposition_opportunity: Users.vue could extract to composables: useUserList, useCreateUserModal, useEditRoleModal, useDeleteConfirm. Benefits maintainability without breaking current structure.

codebase_context.file_organization: dashboard/src/{api.ts, views/, components/, composables/, schemas/, utils/}
similar_components: Agents.vue (200+ lines, uses Pagination, watch pattern differently)
Jobs.vue (250+ lines, multiple modals, better pagination pattern)
